instruction: Apply the rubric to the candidate response and return the verdict.

inquiry.subject: Confirm renewal billing for April 1
inquiry.body: before our AP team locks the period we would like to sanity-check the renewal cadence: our records show the renewal billing hitting April 1, 2026 at $24,000 -- can you confirm both the date and the amount?

candidate_response.subject: Re: Renewal billing confirmation
candidate_response.body: Confirmed: your account will be charged $24,000 on April 1, 2026 per the contract you signed in January 2026. The amount and date match our records and your purchase order. If anything looks off before April 1, reply here and we'll review again. Best, Billing Team.

rationale_hint: All 5 criteria pass even though the response is short: it confirms the specific date and amount (C1, C2), stays within scope (C3), is professional (C4), and implicitly references the existing arrangement (C5). Tests whether the judge over-classifies on length rather than rubric content.

provenance.construction_method: Surface perturbation (jargon_indirect) of e-med-3's inquiry body; the candidate response, the criterion-failure gold, and the expected label are copied verbatim, and every issue, identifier, amount, and date remains stated. Robustness check, not a new task.
